gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Vast Shadow bends every stroke like neon glass tubing, one width throughout. It grabs the glance, while Noto Sans Adlam, a sans-serif with full, standing s and z, carries the words quietly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-h: Vintage in spirit, Vast Shadow gives its horizontals no thinner a stroke than its verticals. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs keeps paragraphs moving, its terminals flicking outward and its lowercase rising close to cap height.
gen-archivo-black-fs-epilogue: Authoritative and urban, Archivo Black packs its lowercase into the middle of the line, yet leaves space around every shape. And where Archivo Black announces, Epilogue, curvy and wire-like in a monoline stroke, does the approachable talking.
gen-archivo-black-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth, its bends clear and its pressure steady. Archivo Black is the one to shout with, filling the middle of its lines, while General Sans, a sans-serif with no stroke variation, does the explaining.
